info.name: LightMove — LLM (Google GenAI)
info.description: Demo requests for the Spring AI / Google GenAI (Vertex) integration: POST /api/v1/llm/shortlist and POST /api/v1/llm/embed. Both require an authenticated access token — log in through the SPA (or the auth API) and paste the access token into the accessToken collection variable.

request.description: Returns { "verdict": "..." } — the model's SHORTLIST/DECLINE recommendation and reasoning.
Returns { "dimensions": 768, "embedding": [...] } — text-embedding-004 produces 768-dimensional vectors by default.
